faqs_found.question: Does Buffer work for agencies or businesses managing multiple brands?
faqs_found.answer: Yes. Buffer is built to manage as many accounts as you do, whether those are your own brands or your clients'. Each social account connects as a channel, you manage them all from one dashboard, and you pay per channel rather than per brand or per client â so a portfolio of 30 accounts costs the same whether it's one brand or 15. You can also invite teammates to draft, schedule, and review posts together. To see how agencies and multi-brand teams use Buffer, visit our agency page .

faqs_found.question: What counts as a channel?
faqs_found.answer: A channel is one social account you connect to Buffer â a single Instagram profile, Facebook page, LinkedIn page, TikTok account, and so on. You're billed per channel, so you only pay for the accounts you actually manage. If you run five brands with an Instagram and a Facebook page each, that's 10 channels.

faqs_found.answer: You can choose to pay for your plan on a monthly or annual basis. By selecting annual billing, you'll receive a 20% discount.
